speaker: ophelia
text: You're here. Come in. I'll put the kettle on.
reaction: relief; reach for a familiar task

speaker: mathilda
text: Not yet.
reaction: stop her before welcome becomes avoidance

speaker: ophelia
text: Are you hurt?

speaker: mathilda
text: I'm cold. I'm angry. Those are different things.
reaction: name the feeling rather than accuse

speaker: ophelia
text: I didn't mean for you to go.
reaction: first attempt to undo the action

speaker: mathilda
text: You said go. I needed you to notice that I could.

speaker: ophelia
text: I noticed. I watched the door all night.

speaker: mathilda
text: Then why didn't you open it?

speaker: ophelia
text: Because if you came back angry, I would have to hear you.

speaker: mathilda
text: Yes.

speaker: ophelia
text: I kept thinking of what to say. I never thought of what to ask.

speaker: mathilda
text: Ask me now.
reaction: offer a chance without rescuing her

speaker: ophelia
text: What did you need from me?

speaker: mathilda
text: To let me finish. I said I was unhappy, and you handed me a list.

speaker: ophelia
text: The shopping list.

speaker: mathilda
text: You asked if we needed milk. I was trying to tell you I needed you.
reaction: explain the wound, not a new mystery

speaker: ophelia
text: I heard you. I made it smaller because I knew how to fix milk.

speaker: mathilda
text: You don't have to fix this before you sit beside me.

speaker: ophelia
text: Then I'll sit. And I'll listen until you're finished.

speaker: mathilda
text: I brought your cup back.
reaction: show that anger and care can coexist

speaker: ophelia
text: You kept it?

speaker: mathilda
text: I was angry with you. I didn't want you gone.

speaker: ophelia
text: May I take it?

speaker: mathilda
text: Yes. Walk beside me.
reaction: consent and a small shared action

speaker: mathilda
text: You left the lantern burning.
reaction: topic at 01, once; the light she watched from the tent

speaker: ophelia
text: I didn't know what else to keep lit.
reaction: a plain truth, not a plea

speaker: mathilda
text: Only my hands. You knitted the gloves too small.
reaction: topic at 03 after examining the gloves, once; deflect with a joke

speaker: ophelia
text: You said they were perfect.

speaker: mathilda
text: You said it like you meant it.
reaction: topic at 05, once; refuse the easy retraction

speaker: ophelia
text: I did. For as long as it took to say it.

speaker: mathilda
text: I left you a note. It says something different every time I read it.
reaction: topic at 07 after examining the note, once

speaker: ophelia
text: I read it in your voice. Then in mine. So I stopped reading.

speaker: mathilda
text: I'm not sure I know any more.
reaction: topic at 13, once; she is allowed not to know yet

speaker: ophelia
text: Then I'll wait while you find it.
reaction: she waits instead of filling the silence

speaker: mathilda
text: Not yet. Sit with me out here first.
reaction: the other answer to 23; consent deferred, not refused

speaker: ophelia
text: Out here. All right.

speaker: mathilda
text: I need a minute.

speaker: ophelia
text: I'll be here. I'm not going in without you.
reaction: she does not follow and does not close the door

speaker: ophelia
text: Still here. Go on.
reaction: greeting when Mathilda comes back to the conversation
